hoovering.alt: Close up, a peach nim picks up a berry, drops it straight behind itself and goes for the next, over and over.

clover-gen0.alt: Generation 0, no practice: a peach nim moves at random, turns grey and stops. It starved after 1 minute 11.

clover-gen1.alt: Generation 1, 23 hours of practice: the nim finds berries, then wanders off along the hedge and loses track of them.

clover-gen2.alt: Generation 2, 46 hours of practice: sped up, the nim goes berry to berry and survives all 3 minutes, 49 berries.

clover-final.alt: Generation 13, the 0.2 brain after 11.6 days of practice: the nim heads for each berry it sees. It never starved in 64 tests.

hoovering-overview.alt: The whole garden at four times speed: three colonies sweep the lawn, leaving dropped berries everywhere and nothing at their nests.

nights-piles.alt: Sped up: three colonies with jelly piling up in their nests, while nims starve right beside it.

nights-first.alt: Night falls on the first night brain. The nims stay out in the dark and all 18 of them freeze.

nights-now.alt: The RL-only brain after the automated forks: at dusk every nim heads home, they huddle on the nest and spin all night, and at first light they head out again.

colonies-timelapse.alt: The 0.3 brain's whole six minutes at 15 times speed: three days and three nights. By day the colonies spread out to forage, at dusk they crowd onto their nests, and new nims hatch in the dark. They start as 18 and end as 19.

colonies-hatch.alt: Sped up, two eggs sit on a purple colony's nest while its nims come and go. Back at normal speed, an egg cracks and a small nim comes out and grows to full size.

colonies-flower.alt: A rainbow nectar flower opens on the lawn among a crowd of nims. One sprints at it, kicking up a trail of dust, and eats it whole, in slow motion at the end.

colonies-turbo.alt: Turbo mode: the nim that ate the flower runs off sparkling, faster than the others, its face toward the camera, then on past its nest.

colonies-starve.alt: Just after the third dawn, a purple nim out on the lawn slows, greys and starves, and a small tombstone is left where it fell.

nursery-tag.alt: Five baby nims play tag among wooden blocks. The one who's it glows yellow underneath; one sprints, kicking up dust.

nursery-blindspot.alt: The it's view drawn as a pale fan in front of it. A runner tucks in close behind, out of the fan, and the two go round in a tight circle.

nursery-ears.alt: The same game with hearing on: the it turns to a runner behind it and tags it.

nursery-seek.alt: Hide-and-seek: after the count, a seeker heads round the walls straight to a hider.

nursery-peek.alt: Peekaboo: a berry shows for a moment and vanishes, the baby is spun round, then turns back and goes straight to where the berry was.

nursery-tagbacks.alt: Two babies stand touching and pass being it back and forth every two seconds, while the others wander.

nursery-wall.alt: A baby parked in a corner, face against the hedge, eating each berry as it appears at its nose.

nursery-lap.alt: A baby runs a fixed lap of the arena at full speed and runs into each hidden berry along the way.

nursery-tidy.alt: A baby nim beside its nest picks up a dropping, sets it down a little further out, and picks it up again until it's past the dashed line.

tree-remembered.alt: Side by side, the same game twice. On the left a nim comes up from its burrow and walks straight back to an apple tree it can't see, again and again. On the right its memory is wiped each time it goes home, and it wanders.

tree-moved.alt: Side by side, the same game twice. On the left the tree stays put. On the right the tree moves while the nim is in its burrow; it walks to the empty spot where the tree was, looks about, then crosses the garden and finds the tree in its new place.
